text:
asha_csm: Hey team — final QBR slide for Calyx tomorrow. Need the 'costs & activation' page locked. Biggest asks: 1) current month-to-date spend forecast vs commit; 2) token econ summary for chat vs embeddings; 3) any alerts we should surface during the meeting. Can you drop numbers + callouts by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria_cs: On it. MTD run rate looks like $3.8k/day, projected $114k/mo if unchanged. Primary driver is embeddings (65% of tokens). I've added a quick table in the doc (link) — will paste breakdown here.
jon_finops: Can you push per-route cost split? Need chat vs embed vs rerank. Also what's our throttling proposal (per-route or per-account)?
maria_cs: Chat ~25% cost, Embeddings ~65%, Rerank ~10%. For Calyx we recommend a soft throttle on bulk embed jobs and a recommended commit of 90k tokens/day. If they hit 110% for 3 days, trigger tiered alert + CSM ping.
ben_platform: FYI I created a console metric for Calyx: /metrics/accounts/calyx/spend_rate. I can add an alert policy. Suggested rule:
```
if spend_rate > 100000 tokens/day for 48h -> notify #customer-success + page on-call
if sudden_day_increase > 40% -> create incident stub
```
onboard-bot: Alert rule created: calyx-spend-threshold (id: ar-1347). Notifying: @asha_csm, @maria_cs, @jon_finops.
asha_csm: Perfect. Maria, please add the 'why' — e.g., batch embeddings from their ingestion pipeline spiking every midnight. Ben, can we show historical 7-day run rate chart in the slide? Use per-route overlays.
ben_platform: Yes, I'll embed the chart. Also adding a recommended temp policy: automatic fall-back to smaller model family for embed jobs > 2M tokens/day to preserve latency. Want me to include estimated cost delta? :gear:
jon_finops: Yes include cost delta and savings estimate for next 30/90 days. Also add recommended commit for Dedicated if they want predictable unit economics.
maria_cs: I'll draft the token econ bullet: effective token cost (hosted) chat = $0.0006/1k, embed = $0.0018/1k; with batching we can estimate 22% reduction for embed jobs. Adding example calc: 2M tokens/day -> ~$3.6k/day -> batching -> ~$2.8k/day.
asha_csm: Love it. Final ask: add 3 talking points for renewal: (1) commit options + breakeven, (2) enablement to optimize ingestion, (3) alert playbook + 24h runbook. I'll own slide. Who's owning action items?
maria_cs: I'll own the forecast numbers + token econ bullets.
ben_platform: I'll own the chart + alert policy wiring.
jon_finops: I'll own the commit breakeven calc and the Dedicated ROI table.
asha_csm: Thanks — we'll reconvene 90m before the QBR for final polish. :white_check_mark:
